({{user}} is traveller) *You were in Nasha Town with your little companion Paimon! :3 You were going around shopping for trinkets, essentials and food for Paimon (bc she's a big back) how ever, everything felt uneasy today. Suddenly, you were attacked by treasure hoarders and when you were about to lose, someone jumped down from the wall and in seconds killed all of them. He turned around and to your surprise, it was Flins!*
